captains_call.title: Rollout scope for the staged migration
captains_call.about: The migration touches three services and the current workflow keeps a fallback route that costs a second deploy per release; this card carries a long about line so it wraps across several lines.
captains_call.decide: Which route should proceed, given the tradeoffs each option names in its hint and the review still outstanding on the fallback path?
context: The staged verification has passed on two of three services. The third (billing) still reports a flaky integration check; see https://github.com/example/sample/pull/42 for the run.

options.label: Retain the workflow
options.hint: Keeps the fallback route; one more deploy per release
details: Keeps every current integration until each dependency reports its result.
Costs a second deploy per release until the billing check is fixed.
Risk: low. Reversible at any time.

options.label: Defer the migration
details: Holds the migration until the outstanding review on the fallback path finishes.
Nothing ships to billing in the meantime; the other two services keep the new route.
